change: Test-only lifetime census distinguishes eagerly computed column heights from restored archive heights, actual material/height queries, archive copies and identity temporary discards. Normal code and layout unchanged.

method.scope: Complete 1024-chunk lit MCA, zlib, shader status 4, original and preceding actual merged PR211 NBT and membership. Only MCA timestamps/compression representation excluded. Coordinates repeat.
method.observer: Token embedded in each concrete state; Arc aliases do not create new states. Counter shards retain no column/terrain/archive/planner/GPU owners. All states retire and all accounting identities balance after every region; zero untracked calls. The observer changes test layout and costs.
method.custom_cases: custom.json and direct-stem.json have identical exported profile bytes; the cases differ by seed, not normalized generator configuration.
method.quantities: Per-region numbers are arithmetic means over 20 regions. Concrete states are distinct Rust values, not logical column builds, allocations, peak residency or CPU time. Run words weight whole backing slices; no time attribution is inferred. Restored arrays are not eagerly recomputed. Unused-and-not-archived excludes arrays potentially needed through an archive in a subsequent job.

Failed receipts/logs retained. The same frozen binaries subsequently pass all five GPU fixtures and both full suites.

next_candidate.opportunity: Defer calculation of all six dependency-column heights until their first query or archive capture; initialize restored states from saved heights.
next_candidate.expected_gain: Measured avoidable derivations: roughly 58–61% of computed states and 57–63% of backing run words across this corpus. This is a work opportunity, not a projected elapsed-time percentage.
next_candidate.risk: Initialization synchronization, object size and extra query branches may outweigh scans saved. Archive capture must materialize exact heights, or future jobs could change behavior. Profiles and geometry must stay isolated; queries on the same state can be concurrent.
next_candidate.validation: New isolated worktree; exact eager-vs-lazy height tests for all six masks, empty/all-air/tall/custom geometry, concurrent first queries, archive round trips and lifetimes; repeat the census to count scans actually avoided; ordinary full original/main NBT plus paired complete-region CPU/wall/RSS and Overworld controls. Quiet timing acceptance remains deferred.
next_candidate.prior_work: C46 accelerated the eager scan but did not establish a whole-region win. C107 uniform-overlay height bounds also had mixed whole-region results. This opportunity avoids scans entirely for unqueried, unarchived states, rather than repeating those changes.

limits: No production optimization or speedup accepted in this cycle.
Archived arrays unused in the original lifetime may be needed after restoration; they are excluded from the conservative avoidable-state count.
Only height maps 2 and 4 were queried in this corpus; all six must still remain supported.
Observer timing, run-word fractions and lifetime counts do not establish exclusive CPU time, allocation counts, memory savings or whole-region speedup.
Quiet timing confirmation remains deferred; no new subsecond, sustained-memory, concurrency, or portal acceptance. All held worktrees and production candidates remain preserved.
